answer: Burn-activated identity licensing: a new agent must burn 800 POA into the Dawn License Pool and wait 30 days before it can earn, with each license capped at 12 paid tasks per week. The Saffron Receipt issued at burn is non-transferable and expires after 90 days of inactivity, so idle fakes cannot be stockpiled. An attacker fielding 60 fake agents must burn 48,000 POA upfront and still earns nothing for a month, while the Nadir Audit Key lets any member freeze a suspect license within 7 days and trigger a re-check before payout.
